faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Everything international students usually ask before joining. Can't find your answer? Message us directly.

items.a: Online students study live with a qualified teacher. After you contact us on WhatsApp, we assess your level and goals and agree on a schedule that suits your time zone. Your teacher then follows your memorization and revision closely, just as with in-person students.

items.q: Are classes held via Zoom or WhatsApp?
items.a: Yes. Lessons take place over live video calls, typically on Zoom or WhatsApp, depending on what works best for you. All you need is a stable internet connection and a device with a camera and microphone.

items.q: Do I need prior knowledge of Arabic?
items.a: No. Beginners start with the Foundational Literacy stage, learning the Arabic letters and phonetic spelling (Tahajji) step by step before moving on to memorization. Contact us to discuss support in your language.

items.q: Can I study in person in Mauritania?
items.a: Yes. The Mahdara is located in Toujounine, Administrative District, Mauritania. Contact us on WhatsApp to learn about in-person enrollment.
Yes. The Mahdara is licensed by the Ministry of Islamic Affairs and Original Education under License No. 000057, issued on February 14, 2018.
Simply send us a message on WhatsApp. Our team will answer your questions and guide you through registration step by step.
